title: High-Performance On-Orbit Intelligent Computing and Real-Time Services for Remote Sensing Satellites Based on Large-Scale Computing Power in Space
authors: Guoping Wang; Gang Wan; Zhijuan Su; Yang Wang; Yutong Jia; Gong Li; Shi Liang
affiliations: Space Engineering University, Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing Institute of Space Mechanics and Electricity, Xidian University

problem_statement.en: Traditional remote sensing satellite systems suffer from limited onboard computing power, high latency due to 'space sensing-ground computing' models, and insufficient communication bandwidth for massive data transmission.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統遙感衛星系統受限於星載算力不足、「天基感知-地面計算」模式引發的高延遲，以及海量資料傳輸所需的通訊頻寬不足。

key_innovation.en: A distributed, collaborative space-based cloud computing framework that leverages large-scale, heterogeneous onboard computing resources (CPU+FPGA+GPU+AI) and inter-satellite links to enable real-time, on-orbit intelligent processing.
key_innovation.zh: 一套分散式協同的天基雲計算框架，利用大規模異質星載計算資源（CPU+FPGA+GPU+AI）與星間鏈路，實現即時的在軌智能處理。

key_improvements.en: Achieves up to 275 Tops per kilogram of computing power and 4 Tops/Watt energy efficiency, enabling real-time on-orbit processing and reduced reliance on ground-based data centers.
key_improvements.zh: 每公斤算力最高達 275 TOPS，能效達 4 TOPS/Watt，實現即時在軌處理並降低對地面資料中心的依賴。

experimental_setup.network_topology: Constellation, Formation flying, Satellite-ground integrated network

workload_and_traffic.ai_task: Remote Sensing, Target detection, Semantic segmentation, Change monitoring, Multi-modal fusion, Intelligent task scheduling
workload_and_traffic.traffic_pattern: Inter-satellite communication, Satellite-ground communication, Data downlink, Task-driven request-response

hardware_infrastructure.compute_memory_hw: CPU, GPU, FPGA, AI chips, DSP
hardware_infrastructure.network_hw: Inter-satellite laser communication terminals, TT&C data transmission stations

networking_stack.transport_and_interconnect: Inter-satellite laser communication, Satellite-ground communication links, 6G mobile network
networking_stack.routing_and_congestion_control: Deterministic routing in time-varying networks, Autonomous service migration
